rationale: Closes the $18.3k cash deficit by extending Town Shop fulfillment through Day 30 to capture late-harvest 2.0x-3.5x contract premiums, upgrading Oracle Frontrun into a dual peak-arbitrage and glut-defense engine (selling at >=1.15x base price), and accelerating early workforce scaling via a lean $120 hurdle when under 10 hands. Constrains upstream market/procurement nodes to a strict 2-order cap per step to preserve worker dispatch bandwidth under the 10-order engine limit, caps land expansion at day 22 to prevent worker dispersion traps, and institutes full-capacity hand drop-offs to eliminate single-item transit waste.
